args.title: Fix export filename to use local date instead of UTC
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Update formatExportFilename to construct the date string using local date components (getFullYear(), getMonth(), getDate()) instead of toISOString(), so the exported filename reflects the local date of the Date object rather than UTC.

label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

formatExportFilename uses toISOString() which produces UTC dates, causing western time zone evening exports to display the wrong calendar date.

args.title: Clarify money storage and minor unit handling in src/util/money.ts
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Clarify currency storage representation and minor unit handling for currencies without minor units such as JPY and KRW.

label: question
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Money is stored as integer minor units (bigint) alongside an ISO 4217 code. Currencies without minor units like JPY and KRW are stored as whole units to prevent floating-point rounding errors.

args.title: Preserve non-Latin characters in slugify utility
args.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

Update the slugify utility to preserve non-Latin characters such as Greek and Cyrillic instead of stripping them out with a strict [^a-z0-9]+ regex, ensuring report export filenames with non-Latin characters are formatted correctly.

label: bug
file: src/util/strings.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

slugify in src/util/strings.ts replaces [^a-z0-9]+ with hyphens, stripping out non-Latin characters like Greek and Cyrillic when formatting report export filenames in src/exportUtils.ts.

args.body:

Clear any previous upload error by calling setProblem(null) when a new file is chosen via onChange on the file input.

label: bug

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

When a new file is chosen via onChange on the file input, setFile is called, but setProblem(null) is not called to clear any previous upload error.
